title: The Rhythm of Your Breath Leaves a Fingerprint on Your Thoughts - Nautilus
gist: A Journal of Neuroscience study finds electrical signaling in limbic and cortical brain regions tracks the specific shape of each breath on a millisecond basis, like a fingerprint, deepening the known breath-cognition link.
